1.consolidated_definition: Público, auditorio, concurrencia. Conjunto de oyentes o espectadores que asiste a un acto o espectáculo, de radio, televisión u otros. Desvío semántico, usual. DRAE: desde 1984. Chayanne reconquistó a la audiencia con la interpretación de clásicos de su repertorio como Tu pirata soy yo, El centro de mi corazón y Fuiste un trozo de hielo en la escarcha (El Nuevo Día, 23-10-97)
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Audience, public, congregation. A group of listeners or spectators attending a performance, broadcast, television show, or other event. Semantic shift, common usage. (From the Real Academia Española dictionary since 1984.)

Note: El Nuevo Día is a Puerto Rican newspaper, and Chayanne is a well-known Puerto Rican singer. The reference to "Tu pirata soy yo", "El centro de mi corazón" and "Fuiste un trozo de hielo en la escarcha" are song titles by Chayanne that were mentioned in the article as part of his repertoire, but they have been translated for context only.
